{{nihongo|'''Kamo-no-Ōkami-no-mikokaminushitama Shrine'''|鴨大神御子神主玉神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Hitachi Province]].
